title: *GENERAL PHYSICS WITH CALCULUS
description: Extends models based on forces and energy to describe and quantify the fundamental physical phenomena of electricity and magnetism. Applies models for electric and magnetic forces to predict, describe, and explain the behavior of both simple and complicated systems. Explores how multiple representations, mathematical sensemaking, and physical explanations strengthen the construction and deployment of the models. Explores the methods by which physics is built through experiment and observation.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: PH 212 or 212H.
A minimum grade of C- is required in PH 212 and PH 212H.
